chapter: Blackbirds, Carmen Jones and the Ziegfeld Follies
title: Seeing Buck and Bubbles on the marquee
summary: Next morning the marquee has their name in lights; they get a star dressing room with a phone and stop the show.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: My manager didn't know and my partner didn't know that I had it in my mind not to go on the stage any more and I was going to quit show business if

Buck and Bubbles won't be headlining that theater tomorrow. He didn't know that. So as I near the theater in the cab and saw this marquee with Buck and Bubbles in a banner over the marquee, Buck and Bubbles in lights around the marquee and even under the marquee they had Buck and Bubbles across on a banner. Well, I said to myself, who could have told them. What do they care? And I went to the theater, went backstage and the stage manager says -- come on in, Mr. Bubbles -- the first he said Mr. Bubbles since I've been coming to the theater over five years and played the theater two or three times every year. However, they give us the star dressing room with a phone in the room -- the first time we had a phone in the dressing room and Buck would rehearse the music and got the rehearsal over, he comes down for the show -- we went on to the first show and the audience didn't know what to think of Buck and Bubbles because it was the first time in any act that

they brought a headline that had anything to offer. They'd bring in movie stars out there and just headlines, they weren't doing nothing. Walk on the stage and this is Miss so-and-so-and-so. And that was it. But when Buck and Bubbles got on and give them an act that everybody enjoyed, we couldn't get off the stage. We stopped the show cold.
